evidence.title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots

summary: Researchers have developed a new AI framework that allows space robots to continuously adapt to unforeseen conditions without relying on predefined reward signals. This reward‑free continual learning approach enhances the resilience and autonomy of robotic systems operating in the harsh and unpredictable environment of space.
title: AI Enables Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
